run_dedup_files_pipeline: run the dedup_files pipeline to iteratively deduplicate a glob of text files using merge sort
launch_dedup_single_batch: launch a single dedup job on a list of shard files using DedupeWithMergeSort via a launcher
configure_dedup_config: create a DedupConfig dataclass to set output file, glob pattern, merge dir, and resource limits
review_DedupConfig: review the DedupConfig dataclass fields including num_cpu, mem_gb, timeout_min, and resort_files options
summarize_dedup_files: summarize the async dedup_files function that chunks files and iteratively deduplicates until one remains
